# IMatch.CameraArea property

The part of the level the camera keeps the runners in, in level units: a runner left outside it is eliminated. It is the whole screen until sudden death shrinks it, leaving the sudden death borders around it. Null outside a match.

public Rectangle? CameraArea { get; }
